entities.summary: Roman Republic, a political institution in Malta during Carthaginian and Roman Malta (218 BCE–395). Grew from Legendary shipwreck of the Apostle Paul on Malta (60 AD) and Carthaginian Rule. Led to the emergence of Arab conquest of Malta — origins of the Maltese language's Semitic roots.
